facts.why: the registry knowing a source is the precondition for every other fact. It is NOT an approval - 177 sources are registered and none is approved.
whether the source's terms permit automated collection. A human decision; 171 of 177 sources block here because there was nowhere to record one until this gate.
the guard exposes `human_review_required` as an OUTPUT rather than taking a review verdict as input, so the review decision gates authorization here instead. 6 of 177 sources block on this.
whether an operator activated this source, recorded with who and when. Already persisted by nf_active_opportunity_sources; this gate composes it rather than adding a second approval column.
whether a collector for this source is running at all

whether robots.txt permits the path. Requires FETCHING robots.txt, which is itself a live call - so this fact is unresolvable in Gate 162 and refuses as missing. Gate 163 is where that fetch is first permitted, and it is the first live call the campaign makes.
whether a required credential is present. Measured from settings; the VALUE is never read, recorded or reported.
whether a per-host rate limit policy is declared. Politeness is not optional, so an undeclared policy refuses.
whether the request would identify itself canonically. Derived by comparing against the one canonical string, not by a caller asserting it.
whether required attribution is present and verbatim. Applies where the source's terms demand it.

whether the Gates 156-161 runtime can actually carry a collection. Necessary and emphatically not sufficient: a ready runtime authorizes nothing, which is the distinction this whole block exists to keep.

missing_is_not_denied: nobody has decided and somebody decided against are opposite operational situations with the same effect on permission. A boolean cannot tell them apart, so this model does not use one.
not_an_approval: a registered source is not an approved source
an available adapter is not an approved source
a queued job is not an approved source
a schedulable source is not an approved source
a ready runtime is not an approved source
a successful hermetic execution is not an approved source
an execution proof is not an approved source

refusal_meaning.denied: a decision exists and it says no. Changing this needs a new decision.
refusal_meaning.missing: no record exists. Nobody has decided this, which is not the same as somebody deciding against it.
refusal_meaning.needs_review: a decision exists and defers to a human who has not answered yet
refusal_meaning.stale: a record answered and the answer expired. The evidence is about a document or state that may have changed since.
refusal_meaning.unknown: a record exists but does not answer the question - usually a column that was never populated

vocabularies_are_read_from: live_network_guard_service. This module restates none of them; a second copy of a vocabulary is a second thing to drift.
